description: From the lakeshore at the Dispilio open-air museum, round and rectangular reed-and-timber huts stand on wooden piles in shallow water, linked by a plank walkway. Reeds edge the near shore, and low hills sit across Lake Orestiada. The sky is clear, about 2 percent cloud, about 10.8°C, with wind near 1 km/h. This is the Neolithic reconstruction, not the Kastoria town waterfront.
